The common kingfisher o kingfisher is a species of coraciiform bird of the Alcedinidae family, which inhabits lakes and rivers in Europe, South America, Africa and Asia.
A Common Kingfisher shaking off and twisting its head, taken at Wilpattu National Park, Sri Lanka.
